The most recent New York governor elected as a Republican is **George Pataki** (1994).  
When he ran in the 1994 gubernatorial election the only parties that appeared on his ballot line were:

| Party listed on the ballot | Source |

| **Republican Party** | 1994 New York gubernatorial election infobox – “Party–Republican” |
| **Conservative Party of New York** | 1994 New York gubernatorial election infobox – “Alliance show Parties – Conservative” |

These were the official ballot names used when Pataki was first elected governor in 1994. The other parties that endorsed him (e.g., Tax Cut Now, Liberal) did not appear as separate ballot lines; only the Republican and Conservative parties were listed.
